name: Ōmachi (Japan)
description: A brown field charged at the centre with the Ōmachi city emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised mountain peak.
history: Municipal flag of Ōmachi, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 December 1954.

features.role: Ōmachi city emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised mountain peak
